```markdown
# Messaging

## Core message

Their own words first: "Every shipment, quoted in one place." Larkspur gives
small freight brokers one screen for every carrier quote.

## Proof points

The site says brokers using it answer a quote request in 4 minutes instead of
40 (larkspur-site.md).

## Objections and answers

"We already have a spreadsheet." The site's answer is that a spreadsheet goes
out of date the moment a carrier changes a rate.

## Words we use and avoid

We say quote, never bid.

## What the material does not show

The material names no public customer, so there is no named proof yet.
```
